opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 1st App. Dist. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 456 U. S. 960.] Motion of ap-*1084pellee for divided argument to permit Multistate Tax Commission to present oral argument as amicus curiae denied.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
